This is not simply an energy crisis. It is a debt, liquidity, food, military, and technology crisis converging through one chokepoint.

“Energy independence” is political theater when oil is priced globally, traded in dollars, financed through banks, insured through global markets, and refined through infrastructure built for specific grades of crude. America can produce record amounts of oil and still import inflation because the price is set at the margin.

The real story is capital allocation. Governments borrow to fund escalation. Defense contractors receive the contracts. Energy producers capture higher prices. Banks finance the debt. The public absorbs the inflation, food costs, higher interest rates, and declining living standards. Gains are privatized. Risks are transferred to taxpayers.

Meanwhile, the same system is betting the economy on AI data centers that require enormous amounts of reliable energy.

This is not incompetence alone. It is a system following its incentives.

Stop watching the political actors. Follow the debt, the energy, and the capital.
